text:
Elaine: Quick heads-up — we’re opening a small set of Dedicated G620 micro-pools in Lisbon and SaoPaulo today. :tada: Docs + reservation guidance below.
ops-bot: [deploy] created pool g620-lisbon (size=12) and pool g620-saopaulo (size=8) — rollout id=rl-2024-g620-01
Marcus: Nice. Any capacity guarantees or is this burst-only for now?
Elaine: Initial phase is limited-capacity: not part of the global reserved pool yet. We’re offering short-term reservations (10-day window) and a controlled burst bucket for active customers.
John: FYI ops change — burst cap per-org set to 48 GPU-hours/day for these micro-pools until 2025-06-10. Will monitor and relax if utilization low. :warning:
Amy: Heads-up for sales folks: encourage customers with low-latency EU/SA inference to try these; but call out perf delta vs A100. Provide migration doc link.
Elaine: Good point. Add to the blurb: G620 is optimized for mixed-size chat workloads; you may see ~1.6x throughput vs our L-class on short sequences, but A100-class models will still be faster for large-batch training inference.
Marcus: Where’s the customer-facing doc?
Elaine: https://redwood.ai/docs/dedicated/g620-micropools — contains reservation flow, pricing delta, and migration checklist.
infra-team: Operational note — please tag reservations with project codes and region (e.g., `proj-<team>-lisbon`). We’ll run a cleanup job nightly on untagged holds.
John: Migration snippet for engineers (CLI):
```
# check pool status
redwoodctl pools describe g620-lisbon --format table
# reserve 2 gpus for 5 days
redwoodctl reservations create --pool g620-lisbon --count 2 --duration 120h --tags project=my-app
```
Marcus: Any SLA change?
Elaine: SLAs unchanged for Dedicated; these micro-pools are covered under the same uptime SLA but with the caveat of "phase-1 limited capacity" in the doc.
Amy: Pricing note sent to billing — small premium for micro-pool reservations vs standard dedicated reservations.
ops-bot: [alert] monitoring rule created: pool.g620-*-utilization > 80% for 15m -> paging #eng-oncall
John: We'll track latency regressions closely. If any high-error patterns show up, we’ll auto-fallback to L4 pools per routing policy.
Marcus: Thx — please ping infra when the capacity dashboard is public.
Elaine: Dashboard link will be added to the doc by EOD. Thanks everyone. :pray:
